Definition: Ashkenaz, a Japhethite, also his descendants
BiblicalUsage: Ashchenaz or Ashkenaz = "a man as sprinkled: fire as scattered"; 1) a descendant of Japheth; 2) a northern people, perhaps of Bithynia
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
